thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: P1 triggered for service `prefix-cache-pool-az3` (high error rate, 5XX) — Pager: oncall+az3
incident-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-2487654321-prefixcache-az3 (auto) — severity: P1. Runbook: prefix-cache-corruption.
sarah-w: Acked. I'm on it — checking metrics and recent deploys.
mike-s: seeing a spike in eviction and checksum mismatch logs from the prefix cache shard 3. Raw error: `KVChecksumMismatch: expected 0x1f2b, got 0x4c3d`
anjali: copying logs. quick grep: `grep -R "KVChecksumMismatch" /var/log/prefixcache | tail -n 50` shows errors starting at 2487654200 (≈2m before page).
javier: any recent config changes or rolling restarts in az3?
sarah-w: Not that I pushed. Checking deploy history... last deploy to prefix-cache was ~3h ago and rolled fine. No feature flags.
ops_lead: @sarah-w if it's corruption we should avoid full restart until we confirm extent — could trigger mass evictions. Consider read-only fallback.
sarah-w: Agreed. First, isolate affected shard. I'm running `curl -s "http://prefix-cache-az3/shard/3/stats" | jq .` to confirm health.
incident-bot: Automated check: shard 3 error_rate=0.72, avg_p99_latency=890ms, kv_connections=120 (normal 80-100).
mike-s: Also seeing increased 502s from the routing tier into model shards that rely on prefix cache. Customer-facing 502s ~0.6% globally, concentrated in eu-west-3 region.
anjali: Quick triage: collect sample corrupted keys to see if it's disk or in-memory: `redis-cli -h shard3 keys "pref:*" | head` then `dump` for a few keys.
sarah-w: Ran that, a few keys `dump` failed with `ERR invalid data` — looks like on-disk corruption.
javier: Oof. Are we seeing any hardware errors on that host? I'll check node exporter, SMART logs.
ops_lead: We should activate routing fallback to az2 for new requests while keeping current reads local (to avoid losing warm KV). Plan: enable routing policy `fallback: az3->az2` and scale up prefix-cache replicas in az2.
mike-s: +1. Activating canary failover now. Triggering policy: `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --from az3 --to az2 --percent 20` to start gradual shift.
sarah-w: Doing it now. `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --from az3 --to az2 --percent 20 --reason "prefixcache corruption"`
incident-bot: Routing change recorded. Rollout: 20% traffic -> az2.
pagerduty-bot: Pager update: escalation to secondary oncall scheduled in 5m if no resolution.
anjali: I'll start a read-only snapshot from az3 for forensic copies: `prefixcache-snapshot --shard 3 --mode readonly --out /tmp/shard3-snap.snap`
javier: SMART log excerpt: `/dev/nvme0n1: Media and Data Integrity Errors: 12` — looks like a drive issue. Host: az3-prefix-07. Raising hardware replacement.
sarah-w: ok that explains corruption. For immediate mitigation: 1) shift new traffic to az2 (in progress) 2) mark az3-prefix-07 as degraded so autoscaler stops scheduling to it 3) spin up replacement replica in az3 or in az2 depending on capacity.
ops_lead: @javier please file a host replacement ticket with infra and attach SMART logs. @sarah-w coordinate Replacement Mode: do not evict cache whole pool.
mike-s: Traffic telemetry: after 20% fallback we've seen error rate drop to 0.48 on global 5XXs, az3 still 1.8% but decreasing.
sarah-w: I'm going to increase fallback to 60% to speed mitigation. `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --from az3 --to az2 --percent 60`
incident-bot: Routing change recorded. Rollout: 60% traffic -> az2.
anjali: Starting replica bootstrap in az2: `prefixcache-replica --create --shard 3 --region az2 --from-snapshot /tmp/shard3-snap.snap` — may be slow, copying snapshot to az2.
javier: Infra has acked host replacement. ETA 45m for swap. I'll coordinate with on-call infra.
ops_lead: Customer impact assessment: current sustained error rate ~0.3-0.6% for user-facing requests affecting customers using context length >8k (heavy prefix use). No data exfiltration suspected. Logging SLOs: error budget hit risk if not resolved in 2h.
mike-s: Noting customer-visible incidents: a few API partners reported intermittent 502s to chat completions in eu-west-3. Support is being pinged.
sarah-w: I'll prepare rollback plan: if bootstrap fails or persists, we cut reads in az3 and route 100% to az2 and az1; keep write-through disabled to avoid corrupting replicas.
anjali: Snapshot copy finished to az2, starting apply. Replica init logs: `apply_log: 23% ... 47% ...`
incident-bot: Reminder: please update incident status in PagerDuty and add timeline notes.
sarah-w: Added timeline note: "initial detection -> shard disk errors -> routing fallback -> replica bootstrap".
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident annotated. Next escalation window at +30m.
mike-s: After 60% shift, global 5XX down to 0.18%, az3 down to 0.9%. Latency stable.
javier: SMART shows increasing reallocated sectors during replacement prep. Recommend cordon host: `kubectl cordon az3-prefix-07`
ops_lead: Cordon and drain planned. @javier proceed, but coordinate with sarah for cache handoffs.
javier: Cordon done. Drain queued.
sarah-w: Draining gracefully, preserving in-memory warm kv where possible. `prefixcache-graceful-drain --shard 3 --host az3-prefix-07 --preserve-warm`
anjali: Replica in az2 reached 100% and is marked healthy. Promoting to active: `prefixcache-replica --promote --shard 3 --region az2`
incident-bot: Promotion detected. New primary for shard 3 => az2.
mike-s: Post-promotion checks: 5XXs for affected customers drop to ~0.02%. No new errors from promoted replica.
ops_lead: Good. Next steps: 1) decommission corrupted host after hardware replacement 2) rebuild a fresh replica in az3 once hardware replaced 3) run disk-level check on other nodes in pool.
sarah-w: I'll run `fsck` and integrity sweep on all az3 prefix nodes. Also schedule a runbook review to add earlier disk health checks to alerting.
incident-bot: Incident severity updated to P2 (impact contained). Timeline appended.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by primary oncall. Auto-escalation canceled.
anjali: Support note draft: "We observed partial prefix-cache disk corruption in eu-west-3 affecting some requests; we shifted traffic to neighboring zones and promoted healthy replicas; most customers recovered within 10 minutes. No customer data loss detected. Follow-up: hardware replacement and runbook update."
\amsg: :thumbsup:
sarah-w: Passing to next oncall for watch and follow-up. Handing off to @mike-s for next 2 hours.
mike-s: Taking handoff. I'll monitor until the replacement and runbook change are complete.
incident-bot: Thread closed for active pager updates. Please continue postmortem updates in #postmortems when ready"
